exposure: implementation of a quantitative blood loss (QBL) measurement protocol
outcome: number of packed red blood cell units transfused
cohort: The study included patients who delivered at an urban tertiary referral delivery hospital between December 2013 and December 2019, divided into those managed before and after the implementation of a quantitative blood loss protocol.
finding: Adoption of a quantitative blood loss (QBL) protocol was associated with a shorter time to transfusion and reductions in postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) rates and transfusion frequency.
